title: Black Spear for ThunderStrikes Shadows' texture pack
description: A small texture for the netherite Spear on ThunderStrikes Shadows' texture pack. Mainly for spear lovers
body:
As there's no texture for the netherite spear on ThunderStrikes' texture pack, I created one based on the black textures for the netherite tools. 
Mainly thought for the spear mace PVP and as a complement this amazing texture pack. 
Hope you enjoy it :)
